Name: Always Raining in the Valley - Custom NPCs for Sunberry
Author: HimeTarts
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/kbbvf58.png[/img]
[i][b][size=3]Life isn’t about waiting for the storm to pass… It’s about learning to enjoy dancing in the rain.[/size]
[/b][/i]TW // Alcoholism / Drug Addiction / Suicide Ideation / Minor Cursing


[size=3]Have you ever felt lost? Adrift? It's okay not knowing what the next stage of your life will have in store for you. After all, we're all often so lost in our own heads that we forget to connect with the people that surround us. ARV is a mod about growing through those who surround us, learning to live with ourselves when we can't love ourselves, and what has to be an obscene amount of puns.[/size]

🍂Enjoy my work? Please support me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon![/url] No mod content will ever be paywalled, but your support helps me to continue development.🍂﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZRld4YG.png[/img]﻿
[b][size=3]Come spend awhile with the Cooper Family![/size][/b][i]
At the moment, only Sterling is marriageable, while Mia and Henry are antisocial NPCs.[/i][/center]
[left] 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mcEsf8m.png[/img]﻿﻿[size=3]﻿  ﻿[b]Meet Sterling[/b], a 27-year old man who just moved back to the Valley after a disastrous streak at Zuzu City. He is briefly
 ﻿  ﻿        back home and living with his cousin Henry in hopes of turning over a new life and starting back up clean. A challenge
﻿  ﻿   when letting go of a beer bottle is tougher than ever...
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/mcEsf8m.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿  ﻿Meet Henry[/b], Sterling's slightly younger cousin who works on a farm in Grampleton. While he moved away from home to 
﻿  ﻿   live with Mia, and more recently Sterling, he still wakes up bright and early every day to work the family farm. He's a bit of  ﻿  ﻿                             a workaholic, so good luck finding him at home.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mcEsf8m.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿  ﻿[b]Meet Mia[/b], the 26-year-old Agronomist from Gallus City working a contract in Grampleton with a knack for gardening,
﻿  ﻿    intricately shaped food and being the certified single brain cell of the entire Cooper House. A young woman with a 
﻿  ﻿    straight head on her shoulders trying to navigate the complexities of her own gender identity.  ﻿[/size]

﻿
[center] [img]https://i.imgur.com/n0Ny5Ri.png[/img][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]   ﻿[size=3][b]Always Raining in the Valley will feature stories from it's 3 title characters. [/b]This first release consists of [b]Sterling's
 ﻿  ﻿story [/b]and currently features﻿ +[b]20 heart events [/b](ranging from 0-14 hearts), 16 [b]repeatable mini dates,[/b] over
﻿ ﻿[b]60 outfits, letters, 100 locational messages [/b]and more![/size]

  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿Credit to [b]Crooks[/b] for writing Sterling and Shane's make-up event![/left]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/osTlhye.png[/img][/center]
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/u6SXDQe.png[/img]﻿       [size=3]Enjoy the delight of the Cooper family with [b]Mia's [/b][i]adorable[/i] cooking, Sterling's drinks and Henry's family recipes! Please note
﻿  ﻿that some of these are sent by Mia and Henry, and can thus not all be obtained until their marriageable releases.[/size]

[/left]

[/size]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿[size=3]﻿ [/size][size=3]— Download the kids expansion that turns your children with the ARV crew into full NPCs! Comes with expanded
﻿  ﻿  ﻿     marriage content, and a lot of fun surprises![/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]  ﻿[size=3][b]Stardew Valley Expanded, East Scarp, Ridgeside Village, Zuzu City, etc[/b][/size]
﻿  ﻿[size=3]   ﻿[/size][size=3]— ARV is indeed, SVE compatible! As well as with every other expansion mod. Please report any incompatibility.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]  ﻿[b]Immersive Shane & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10675]Dynamic Shane[/url][/b]
﻿      ﻿— Because of how ARV handles its story, ﻿Sterling's story only works when you max out his hearts first, followed by 
﻿  ﻿Shane's. To befriend them both regardless of order, be sure to get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10675]Dynamic Shane & Sterling[/url] which fixes the issue and 
﻿  ﻿adds an optional Rival Hearts between Shane and Sterling!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]  ﻿[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17063]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] recommended!
[/b]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿[size=3]— ARV uses a over 60 outfits for its characters during festivals and seasons. And thus looks best when used alongside 
﻿  ﻿  ﻿DSV for which it has built-in compatibility with!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]  ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17064]DSV Flower Queen's Crown[/url] [b]recommended![/b]
﻿  ﻿  [size=3]— Allows the ARV crew to be randomly selected into the DSV's flower crown pool each year! Being selected comes
﻿  ﻿  ﻿ with brand new dialogue and interactions.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]  ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril & Void[/url] [b]recommended![/b]
﻿  ﻿  ﻿— Features a major storyline with it, including new quests, events and items when both mods are installed!
